## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m manimate.preview <name>` renders and looks right
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] `python -m manimate.catalog > catalog.json` and `python scripts/gen_docs.py` run (CI checks both)
- [ ] No network, files, processes, `eval`/`exec`; plugins (if any) are MIT and listed in `docs/THIRD_PARTY.md`
